delegated_owners.not_built: No second authority-maintenance system was built. Closure and the receipt are the existing owner's objects; the adapter only registers real analytical products and supplies a real recompiler.

real_determinants.dependency_law: The model authority is a genuine determinant: the composed result identity and consumer result hash change when it changes, while the evidence geometry does not. This was measured, not assumed.

registered_products.recompiler: re-runs the accepted compose_positioned_subject_possibility owner under the supplied determinant

real_determinants.consumer_lane_model_authority: C1-AT07-MODEL-REVERSE (direction-scoped, distinct from the mutated determinant)

domain_separation.law: The consumer model authority is direction-scoped in the fixture, so mutating the forward model authority reaches exactly the forward product and leaves the reverse product a genuine unaffected sibling.

proof_obligations_and_how_each_is_met.obligation: all registered affected descendants are invalidated/reidentified/recompiled as governed
proof_obligations_and_how_each_is_met.met_by: the forward product is the sole affected ref and recompiles to a new exact identity via the real composition owner

proof_obligations_and_how_each_is_met.obligation: unaffected sibling remains usable and identity-stable
proof_obligations_and_how_each_is_met.met_by: the reverse product is untouched and recomposes from its own determinants to the same identity with consumer state EXACT_SUPPORTED

proof_obligations_and_how_each_is_met.obligation: the invalidation receipt distinguishes affected from unaffected refs
proof_obligations_and_how_each_is_met.met_by: the owner receipt carries disjoint affected/unaffected tuples

proof_obligations_and_how_each_is_met.obligation: replacement identity is exact where recompilation succeeds
proof_obligations_and_how_each_is_met.met_by: the new pair identity equals the recomposed composition identity computed independently in the court

proof_obligations_and_how_each_is_met.obligation: NO_CURRENT or equivalent noncurrent state is preserved where lawful replacement is unavailable
proof_obligations_and_how_each_is_met.met_by: an involved product without a recompiler is recorded in noncurrent_product_refs with an explicit C1_03R_NONCURRENT_PRODUCT sentinel instead of a fabricated replacement identity

proof_obligations_and_how_each_is_met.obligation: the graph is built from real registrations, not object similarity
proof_obligations_and_how_each_is_met.met_by: every authority edge corresponds to a declared exact determinant of a registered product

limitations: Source-free synthetic fixture; this does not establish live occupancy.
The two registered products are accepted-composition products at the AT07 grain; multi-conditioner/joint dependency closure is not claimed here.
The adapter does not implement the owner's promotion/rollback ceremony; it consumes the owner's graph and receipt contracts.
